messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete for release v2.14.3 -> eu-west-1 at 2024-05-01T15:12:00Z. Kicking off post-deploy checks: synth probes, KV warmup, health checks.

carmen: saw the first synth pass but p95 on /v1/embeddings jumped ~18% in the first 3 min. not full failure, just elevated. :eyes:

ops-bot: [ALERT] synth-probe eu-west-1 /v1/embeddings p95 = 1.42s (baseline 1.20s) | error rate 0.3% | 3 hosts reporting higher latency.

raj: can you paste the probe output? curious if it's tokenization or cold-kv.

lia: pasting quick tail of embed agent logs (truncated):
```
2024-05-01T15:14:05Z INFO prefill: attempting prefix warmup for model redwood-embed-1
2024-05-01T15:14:07Z WARN kvcache: miss rate spike 12% (target <2%)
2024-05-01T15:14:10Z INFO grpc: request latency 1200ms route=/v1/embeddings
```

thomas: looks like KV warmup lag on 3 of the eu-west nodes. those missed their prefill window. might be a scheduling race with autoscaler.

sneha: synth-run snapshot (15:15) attached — shows p95 spike aligns with KV miss windows. other routes (completion/chat) stable.

carmen: proposal: hold the rest of the rollout in eu-west, and either pin routing to v2.14.2 for embeddings route or run a targeted warmup. don't want to rollback whole release unless it persists past the warmup.

raj: +1 to hold and pin variant for eu-west only. we can keep traffic on v2.14.3 for non-embed routes. Do we have a regional pin flag?

lia: we do: `traffic-control regional-pin eu-west-1 /v1/embeddings v2.14.2` (one-liner).

thomas: I'll run a targeted prefill job on the 3 affected hosts and check KV TTLs. ETA ~7 min. command I'll run: `./tools/prefill.sh --region=eu-west-1 --hosts=host-23,host-24,host-27 --model=redwood-embed-1 --prefixes=common_prompts.txt`

carmen: ok let's do this sequence: 1) deploy-bot hold further canary ticks in eu-west, 2) lia apply regional-pin for embeddings, 3) thomas run prefill, 4) sneha monitor synth and give go/no-go after 15 min.

deploy-bot: Hold applied: further canary progression paused for region eu-west-1.

lia: pinned embeddings to v2.14.2 in eu-west-1 (flag id regional-pin/3421).

thomas: prefill job started (job-88431). watching logs.

sneha: monitoring probes now — p95 falling from 1.42s -> 1.25s after first prefill chunk. will wait full 10m window.

carmen: if p95 remains <=1.3s after 10m we remove pin and resume rollout. if it bounces back we'll schedule rollback discussion.

raj: who will update release notes + incident tracking? Carmen?

carmen: I'll update release notes and add an entry to the rollout tracker: eu-west pin applied, cause: KV warmup miss during canary. ETA for resolution check 15:32 UTC.

ops-bot: [INFO] checkpoint saved -> rollout-tracker#rt-2024-05-01-1719504321

thomas: prefill finished on two hosts, still ramping host-27 (IO lag). manual retry in 2m if not warmed.

sneha: marking this thread monitored. will post final status in ~12m. :white_check_mark:
